title: Why Do Coins Have Ridges?
description:
In 1696, people in England were hanged for snipping slivers off silver coins. The fix is still in your pocket: ridged edges, so one snip shows.

Full story (6 everyday shapes) on our channel: "Why Coins Have Ridges, Manholes Are Round and Stop Signs Have 8 Sides".

Sources: The Royal Mint (clipping and counterfeiting cases from the Old Bailey); Great Recoinage of 1696; APS News on William Chaloner.
